record.field:
Disassemble
DO NOT throw away any parts unless told to do so.
Be sure to keep all screws and nuts for reassembly.
Lift and remove the support wire and remove both retaining hooks.
Remove and discard the filament, cathode and anti-cathode by rotating the collect screws 1/4 inch turn to open the clamps. Be sure to close the clamps back.
Remove the arc chamber from the source body. Remove all liners from arc chamber and inspect for excessive wear.
Remove the RH and LH filament clamps and cathode support bar. Remove all 6 insulator shields and ceramic insulators, then remove the upper support.
Damaged insulators should be discarded.
Remove the anti cathode bar. Remove the 2 insulator shields and ceramic insulators, then remove the lower support. Damaged insulators should be discarded.
Remove the 4 screw retaining channels from the upper and lower supports.
Remove both filament rod inserts.
Remove the anit-cathode link strap from the bias feed thru and cathode support bar.
Remove and inspect o-ring from body.
Remove the PWBA source protection circuit board and visually inspect for damage. If damaged write non-conformance report and notify customer.
Remove filament posts.

record.field:
Assemble
Equipment DVM, Calipers
Install the filament posts.
Assemble the upper and lower supports and affix on the source body. Using a pair of pliers, gently snug the insulators.
Install the insulator shields, cathode support bar, filament clamps and anti-cathode bar. Make sure the shields are seated flush on the insulators.
Install the anti-cathodes link strap on the bias feed thru and cathode support bar.
Insert the arc chamber liners into the arc chamber and install on the source body. Ensure arc chamber sits flush on the upper and lower supports. Ensure the smooth, unused side of the liners face the graphite part of the arc chamber.
Install anti-cathode. Ensure anti-cathode is flush up against the shoulder on the anti-cathode bar.
Insert the filament through the aperture side of the new cathode, one leg on each side of the support pin.
Insert cathode and filament through the cathode and filament clamps. Ensure cathode is flush against the end stops of the cathode clamp.
Fit the cathode centering tool over the cathode and clamp the cathode by relaxing the collet screw. Make sure the support bar is vertical.
To set filament spacing, make sure the filament is touching the back of the cathode by measuring the resistance between one filament clamp and the cathode. You should measure a short with the filament contacting the cathode. Then using a digital celipers, measure the distance on the legs of the filament from the filament clamps. The distance should be approximately .80 mm. Then, slide the filament forward to ensure the spacing from the end of the filament to the back of the cathode is 2 mm. Total caliper measurement should be approximately 2.80 mm from the filament ends to the filament clamps. Rotate the collet screws and clamp the filament in place. Remove the centering tool and make sure neither filament legs are touching the support pin.

record.field:
In Process Inspection
Tool: Meg Ohm Meter, Krytek 250
Meter setting: 1000 vdc
Perform the following test using a meg ohm meter set at 1000 vdc.
The HI lead should be attached to the body of the source.
Connect leads between the source body and one of the filament clamps. Reading should be >100 M ohms.
Connect leads between the source body and the cathode support bar. Reading should be >25 M ohms.
Connect leads between one of the filament clamps and the cathode support bar.
If any of the test fails, check the following for possible causes:
* Insulators not seated properly
* Dirty inserts of filament posts (feed throughs)
* Debris and/or plating in feedthrough insulator area.
* Cathode not centered or seated properly.
* Anti-cathode not seated properly
* Filament touching cathode
* Growth on anti-cathode end liner
* Water still in cooling lines
* Tension on anti-cathode link strap causing clearance problems.
Install both front plates on the arc chamber
Install both retaining hooks on the arc chamber to secure the front plates. Ensure springs have good tension.
Perform the slit spacing test on the front plates using the proper spacing block. Replace if needed.
Using the ohm meter, check the resistance between the filament feedthroughs, reading should be a short. Check resistance between one filament feedthrough and the cathode feedthrough, reading should be open. Check resistance between filament strap and cathode, reading should be open. Install a clean o-ring on the source body.
Install the PWBA circuit board on the feedthroughts. Ensure the polarity matches the source body.
Place source in a vacuum or krytek can.
